tips.text: Radshare four players on the same Radiant relic instead of soloing; a 10% Rare becomes 34% for someone, and everyone can pick it.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get extra Void Traces.
Find vaulted radshares through radshare.xyz or the Vaulted Relic Community Discord; recruiting chat is thin for them.
Hold fire at the start of a fissure; enemies killed before they corrupt give no Reactant.
Do not start extraction while a squadmate sits at 9 of 10 Reactant; a relic with less than 10 gives no reward.
Run the Systems relics as an Intact four-player share and save Radiants for the Blueprint and Chassis.
Buy Neo H4 when she stocks it; it carries the Chassis as an Uncommon instead of a Rare.
Buy extra Blueprint and Chassis relics; nearly all of them carry those parts as the Rare.
Check Varzia's actual shelf before spending Aya; she sometimes sells brand-new relic names instead of the old ones.
Finish the whole mission with your squad at extraction; a failed timed Sabotage voids every reward.
Bank Aya before her rotation opens; it never expires.
Radshare keeps the whole frame near 10 to 15 Aya; soloing costs several times more.
Players regret grinding Steel Essence or standing for relic packs; an hour of Deimos bounties pays more Aya.
